description: Get the current average retail diesel price for a US state. Use when the user asks about diesel prices in a specific state, diesel fuel costs by state, or state-level fuel prices. Accepts state names ('California') or 2-letter codes ('CA'). Returns the AAA-sourced state average diesel price. Covers all 50 states plus DC.
name: opa_get_diesel_by_state
title: Get Diesel Price by State
